description: This file defines a plugin for the openclaw system, specifically for integrating xAI functionalities such as code execution and web search. It includes plugin registration, configuration handling, and external API integrations.

methods.name: hasResolvableXaiApiKey
methods.description: Checks if an xAI API key is available via fallback auth or environment variable.

methods.name: isCodeExecutionEnabled
methods.description: Determines if code execution is enabled based on configuration.

methods.name: isXSearchEnabled
methods.description: Determines if xSearch functionality is enabled based on configuration.

methods.name: createLazyCodeExecutionTool
methods.description: Creates a lazy-loaded code execution tool if enabled in config.

methods.name: createLazyXSearchTool
methods.description: Creates a lazy-loaded xSearch tool if enabled in config.
